details.description: Aura-2 is Deepgram's second-generation text-to-speech model, positioned for enterprise voice agents and conversational AI. Deepgram's TTS Models documentation lists Aura-2 voices in English, Spanish, German, French, Dutch, Italian and Japanese, each tagged with characteristics and a recommended use case such as customer service, healthcare or IVR. Deepgram's Text-to-Speech product page features a case study describing Aura-2 powering a healthcare customer's voice agents with natural, low-latency, cost-predictable speech.
advantages: Offers voices across seven documented languages, each tagged with characteristics and a recommended use case, per Deepgram's TTS Models documentation.
Five Spanish voices (Aquila, Carina, Diana, Javier and Selena) code-switch between English and Spanish, per Deepgram's TTS Models documentation.
disadvantages: Limited to 2000 characters per request, the same limit as Aura (v1), per Deepgram's Text-to-Speech guide.
use_cases: Healthcare voice agents, per Deepgram's Text-to-Speech product page.
Interactive voice response (IVR) and conversational AI applications, per Deepgram's TTS Models documentation voice use-case tags.
Customer service voice agents, per Deepgram's TTS Models documentation voice use-case tags.

notes: Deepgram's TTS Models docs enumerate Aura-2 voices in seven named languages (English, Spanish, German, French, Dutch, Italian, Japanese); this is complete, not a gap. The prior draft's '80ms latency', 'lowest word error rate', '24kHz/no SSML' and 'ten languages' claims were pulled from deepgram.com/product/text-to-speech, but that page's current title and hero copy ('Deepgram Flux TTS: Text-to-Speech for Enterprise Deployment', cross-turn context, interruption handling) show those figures describe Flux TTS, a separate, newer Deepgram model launched Aug 2026 (confirmed via the same page's linked press release, which is entirely about Flux TTS and never mentions Aura-2) -- not Aura-2. Removed as WRONG_MODEL. The page's Vida case study does explicitly name Aura-2 for healthcare voice agents, so that use case and source are kept. Catalog carries no deprecation_date; no source marks Aura-2 as legacy or deprecated.
